findings.title: Diff reverts the previous commit's switch to a preconfigured jinja2.Environment and goes back to the deprecated **env_options passthrough
findings.problem: The line undoes commit e11187e, whose message says Starlette dropped the **env_options passthrough and names env= with a preconfigured jinja2.Environment as the supported API. Installed Starlette emits a DeprecationWarning for any env_options. On a newer Starlette where the passthrough is gone, construction at import time fails or the kwarg is not honored; routes.py is imported by __main__.py, scheduler.py and the tests, so an import-time failure stops the whole daemon.
findings.fix_hint: Keep the e11187e form: jinja2.Environment(loader=FileSystemLoader(...), autoescape=True) and Jinja2Templates(env=_jinja_env).
findings.why_it_matters: Reintroduces a deprecated call the repo had just moved away from on purpose; autoescape is the project's XSS guard.

members.title: Autoescape protection downgraded to a deprecated, version-fragile Starlette path (stored/reflected XSS risk)
members.problem: The diff removes the explicit jinja2.Environment(autoescape=True) and reverts to Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True). Installed starlette 0.52.1 warns that extra environment options are deprecated and only honors autoescape via _create_env's setdefault, a path marked for removal. Commit e11187e states this passthrough already broke autoescape once. fastapi is unpinned. Templates render user-controlled data from query_params/form() at routes.py:356,397,600,804 across many TemplateResponse calls.

members.why_it_matters: Autoescape is the only thing preventing user-supplied form/query data rendered in these templates from executing as script; this makes it depend on a mechanism Starlette marks deprecated-for-removal and that this codebase has already seen break once.
members.fix_hint: revert to a preconfigured jinja2.Environment(loader=jinja2.FileSystemLoader(...), autoescape=True) passed via Jinja2Templates(env=_jinja_env), as commit e11187e did

members.title: Preserve explicit escaping against cross-site scripting
members.problem: Line 45 moves autoescape=True from Jinja's Environment constructor into Starlette's deprecated environment-options forwarding path. Installed Starlette 0.52.1 emits a DeprecationWarning recommending the previous implementation. Escaping works today, as verified with an HTML payload, but Docker installs unconstrained dependencies without uv.lock. This makes the protection version-dependent. If escaping lapses, values such as entry.name in templates/partials/search_log.html:19 could execute injected HTML. This is a deprecated-control dependency, not a demonstrated current XSS exploit.

members.title: Revert puts the HTML autoescape setting (the XSS guard) back on Starlette's deprecated **env_options path, and the Docker build installs whatever Starlette version is newest
members.problem: This diff reverts commit e11187e. Installed Starlette forwards env_options with a DeprecationWarning. The Dockerfile runs pip install . against unpinned fastapi/jinja2, so the production image pulls the newest Starlette. If **env_options is gone, autoescape=True raises TypeError at import and every importer fails. If accepted and dropped, escaping depends only on a library default. All 11 TemplateResponse sites render through this env.

members.why_it_matters: The whole app can fail to start in fresh Docker builds, or the guarantee that every template escapes HTML rests on an upstream default instead of explicit code.
members.fix_hint: Drop this revert and keep the explicit jinja2.Environment passed as Jinja2Templates(env=...); also pin or cap starlette/fastapi, or install from uv.lock in the Dockerfile.

members.title: Revert to deprecated Jinja2Templates(**env_options) makes template autoescape (XSS protection) and app startup depend on the Starlette version
members.problem: This diff undoes commit e11187e, which replaced Jinja2Templates(directory=..., autoescape=True) with a preconfigured jinja2.Environment passed as env=. Installed Starlette still accepts **env_options but emits a DeprecationWarning; autoescape then comes only from _create_env's setdefault. fastapi is unpinned, so once a Starlette version drops **env_options this line raises TypeError at import and the web UI fails to start.
